title: feat(tooling): port the comment-mask corpus sweep and measure objectui#7882 residue
body:
Part of #7882 (port of objectstack's corpus sweep; the measurement is on the card)

This PR is the **instrument**. The **measurement** the ruling asked for is posted as a comment on #7882, and the PR deliberately carries no closing keyword: the PM decides on the reading whether that card closes or returns to the decision box.

## The ruling this implements

Quoted from the card's ruling comment (`5565859060`, 2026-09-07):

> 1. **`js-comment-mask` stays a cheap, language-level masker.** ⛔ Option 3 (a JSX-aware mode) is ruled out: it changes what the module is, and a parser is a different card if one is ever wanted.
> 2. **Port objectstack's corpus sweep** (`scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, named in this module's own header as not yet ported) and measure the residue against an independent parser — which direction it fails in, and which gates' verdicts it can move. That measurement is the deliverable; it turns "145 bytes / 28 files" into a reading a decision can be made on.
> 3. The four `KNOWN LIMITS` pins in `scripts/__tests__/js-comment-mask-jsx-6891.test.ts` stay until a fix retires them deliberately. ⛔ Nothing closes this card silently.

`scanSource` and the discriminator are **untouched**, and so are the four `KNOWN LIMITS` pins (they still pass — 50 tests across both mask test files).

## The reading (on `b6f821a8b`)

| | |
|---|---|
| files swept | 4,418 |
| unparseable | 0 |
| files disagreeing with the parser | **1** |
| FABRICATES bytes | **0** |
| OVER-MASKS bytes | **1,517** |
| wall clock | ~33 s |

The single disagreement is `apps/console/src/pages/DocsIndex.tsx`. The JSX text `src/docs/*.md` puts a `/` immediately before a `*`, so the masker opens a phantom **block comment** — not the phantom regex the card leads with — and because no terminator follows anywhere in the file, it runs from line 63 to EOF: 37 lines of live JSX handed to every masking gate as prose.

**No gate's verdict moves.** Of the seven gates under `scripts/` importing the masker, exactly two ever open that file (`check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`; the other five never read it). Both were run against the tree as-is and against a copy with the phantom closed by a one-character edit: both exit 0 either way, with byte-identical output.

The card's headline number re-derives **exactly** (145 literal bytes, 28 files, 0 comment bytes moved) — but it is a different measurement from this sweep's, and the header says so rather than letting one be read as the other.

## Four declared divergences from upstream

1. **The oracle is reached through `typescript-eslint`**, not `@typescript-eslint/parser`. The latter is not declared at this repo's root and does not even resolve there under pnpm's isolated `node_modules` (measured: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`). The meta-package is already a root devDependency at the same version and re-exports the same parser, so the port adds **no new dependency** and no lockfile movement.
2. **The prerequisite helper is inlined** (~15 lines) rather than porting objectstack's `scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs` (1,448 lines) for one function.
3. **The skip list is this tree's own** — upstream's `.cache` entry is objectstack-only; this tree's generated directories are named instead. `apps/site/.source` really was in the corpus before this entry.
4. **The posture is REPORT-with-a-ceiling**, not fail-on-any-disagreement. Upstream's tree sweeps clean and has no known-residue posture; this tree's residue is live and deliberately pinned, so landing upstream's posture unchanged would have turned a green tree red on day one. A **fabricated** byte is fatal (currently zero); over-masking is reported against a ceiling. ⛔ The ceiling is a ceiling, not an allowlist to raise.

## Also repaired: an argument-parsing defect inherited from upstream

With `--masker` absent, `indexOf` returns `-1`, so the filter meant to drop the flag pair dropped `argv[0]` instead — removing an unknown FIRST option from the very list the unknown-option check reads. `--anything` therefore ran a full sweep and exited 0 rather than reporting a usage error. The port's own test caught it on its first run. Reported upstream as objectstack#16540.

## Gates (exit codes captured by redirect, never through a pipe)

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-comment-mask-corpus.test.ts` | 0 (28 tests) |
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__/js-comment-mask*.test.ts` | 0 (50 tests, KNOWN LIMITS pins intact) |
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__/` (whole scripts suite) | 0 (116 files, 3,443 tests) |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --self-test` | 0 (23 cases) |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (the sweep) | 0 — REPORT posture, within the declared ceiling |
| positive control: `--masker` at a blind masker | **1** (4,370 of 4,418 files, 21,602,924 fabricated bytes) |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs --no-such-flag` | 2 (usage) |
| `pnpm check:phantom-deps` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:entry-guard` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:upstream-port-parity` | 0 |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 (0 errors; the 32 warnings are pre-existing, none in the new files) |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 — no changeset owed (no released-package source or published contract moved) |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (all 4 paths) | 0 — NOT GOVERNED |

The positive control is a **blind masker in a temp dir**, not the pre-#6891 masker: pointing `--masker` at the pre-fix implementation was measured and produces an **identical** reading (exit 0), because that phantom lives in the LITERAL flag array and moves zero comment bytes tree-wide. That is recorded in the header as a property of the instrument, not as a caveat — a comment-array comparator is blind to that half by construction.

## Files

- `scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` (new) — the port
- `scripts/__tests__/check-comment-mask-corpus.test.ts` (new) — verdicts read as numbers, sweep driven RED over fixture trees
- `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` — header only: the paragraph claiming the sweep is unported, plus a measured note that porting it did **not** close the `REGEX_AFTER_KEYWORD` mutation gap (checked, not assumed)
- `package.json` — `check:comment-mask-corpus`, next to its siblings. ⛔ No workflow edits; the script is not wired into CI by this PR.
